answer_text: Design verification MC - requires ngspice simulation to determine actual failing specs

choices.A: Power consumption exceeds the maximum limit
choices.B: Cutoff frequency is outside the tolerance range
choices.C: Phase margin is insufficient for stability
choices.D: Passband gain does not meet the target
choices.F: Center frequency deviates from target by >10%
choices.H: DC gain is below the minimum requirement
choices.J: Quality factor Q is too low
